desert.title: Modular Post Apocalyptic Desert Environment (Desert City,Desert Village)

license_policy: Already-owned third-party packs. Original grant applies; not CC0. All vendor bytes and derivatives stay in ignored local Content paths. Public recipe/provenance contains names and hashes only, not asset contents.

channels.source: Tools/routenature/inspect_assets.py native material traversal, saved report native-source-inspection.json
channels.opaque: MM_Megascan_01a node11 Base Mask outputR ->node6 Multiply Base Roughness Multi ->node2 MakeMaterialAttributes. Actual per-instance Base Mask resolved; DpR filename is not used to infer channels.
channels.grass: MM_Foliage node1 2.ARM outputG ->MP_ROUGHNESS; node6 1.Albedo outputA ->node4 Multiply ->MP_OPACITY_MASK.
channels.scrub: M_MS_Foliage node26 ORT G ->node1 Multiply ->MP_ROUGHNESS, ORT R ->node3 Multiply ->MP_OPACITY_MASK. Billboard parent node56 uses same G/R.
channels.base_normal: Actual per-instance Base Color/Albedo and Base Normal/Normal texture values from native MaterialEditingLibrary. Direct RGB on original UV0; no upblend/wetness/detail-normal/world systems.

scope: Eight locally owned vendor copies only; original source packs byte-preserved; all derivatives remain ignored/private. Runtime placement and cooked acceptance are separate.

geometry_verification.source: Original private package bytes/hash retained; every available source MeshDescription vertex/triangle count and complete reflected Nanite/build/reduction settings match the unchanged source copy. No full vertex-buffer hash is claimed.
geometry_verification.render_lods: GetNumTriangles(i) reads built RenderData at every LOD, not authored source. All render LOD counts are separately reported and bounded to 15 percent of inspected counts; source LOD count and all source/build/reduction/Nanite settings remain exact. Independent RT proxy does not alter source settings.
geometry_verification.resume: Actual native bindings/proxy/metadata/settings are checked before skipping setters and save on completed assets.
geometry_verification.maintenance_verify: Optional read-only fresh process; not an additional required delivery run.
